name: @kairotic/theory
description: Kairotic music-theory views: pcclock (a pitch-class set on the clock, its prime form and symmetries), fourier (the six Fourier coefficients of a pitch-class distribution) and tonnetz (triads on the Tonnetz and the path of the harmony), drawn in the patch and clickable; and comes, counterpoint live: you play the dux and the comes answers, reading it at a speed — a canon, an augmentation, or a crab or table canon written from both ends to the middle
author: bonuoq
